columns.validationmsg: 'Flat Discount should be greater equal zero'
columns.name: flatdisc

columns.validationmsg: 'Miscellaneous Charges should be greater equal zero'
columns.name: misccharges

table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	saleledger.flatdisc,   
	saleledger.misccharges,   

	saleledger.MiscCharges1,
	saleledger.MiscCharges2,
	saleledger.MiscCharges3,
	saleledger.MiscCharges4,
	saleledger.MiscCharges5,

	saleledger.salestax,   
	saleledger.discperc,
	Icode = 0, 
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	Stock = 0.0000,
	TotalStock = 0.0000,
	PiecesInHand=0,
	Total = 0.00,
	purdiscperc = 0.00,
	InvGSTPerc1= saleledger.Invgstperc1,
	AdvanceTaxAmt = saleledger.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	avgprice=0.000,
	rpp=0.00,
	rppmargin=0.00,
	purprice=0.00,
	BonusRatio=SPACE(20),
	retailprice=0.00,
	grossforaccumdisc = 0.00,
	totaldiscount = 0.00,
	accumulateddiscperc = 0.00,
	LatestNetRate=0.00,
	salereturnamt = ISNULL((SELECT netamt=dbo.fn_GetSRBufferInvTotal(SRBufferInvCode)), 0.00),
	CurrencyCode,
	ConversionRate
FROM 
	saleledger  
WHERE 
	saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_invcode
